release_notes: Build 127 simplifies Library platform tracking so each normal quiz row shows YT for the full YouTube quiz and compact FB / IG social follow-through state for that same release.

Facebook and Instagram cells now use a simple tick when the promo is posted, a cross when it needs action, and a dash while the YouTube release is not due yet; hovering keeps the detailed state available.
The redundant IG promo column and legacy Status column are removed from Library, reducing horizontal clutter.
Stage and Next action columns are widened so lifecycle labels are readable instead of clipped.
The existing automatic Instagram follow-through, Needs You fallback and live publication-state refresh remain unchanged.
